about_title: Websites that do not try to be something they are not – they simply present what a business does well.
about_p1: The goal of Laszlo-MesterWeb is simple: create modern, clear and easy-to-use websites that help local businesses build a stronger online presence.
about_p2: The foundation is reusable, so different versions can later be created efficiently for many professions.

consult_title: More than just a good-looking website.
consult_text: I create clear, practical websites that help present your business, build trust and make it easier for potential customers to contact you.
consult_1_text: Your website is easy to use on phones, tablets and desktop computers.
consult_2_text: Clear headings, metadata and technical foundations help search engines understand your website.
consult_3_text: Your colours, images, services, text and contact options are brought together in a website that reflects your business.
choice_intro: Not every business needs the same solution. I help you decide whether a focused landing page or a more detailed multi-page website would support your business better.
choice_landing_text: One well-structured page with one clear goal: present the service, build trust and guide the visitor quickly towards a phone call, WhatsApp message or quote request.
choice_landing_best: A good choice for: one main service, a campaign or fast lead generation.
choice_website_text: If you want to present several services, references, a gallery, prices, FAQs and a detailed introduction in an organised way, a multi-page website gives you more room.
choice_website_best: A good choice for: several services, detailed presentation and long-term growth.
choice_social_title: You do not have to choose between them.
choice_social_text: Facebook and Instagram are excellent for attracting attention and showing recent work. Your own website provides an organised, independent place where visitors can easily find services, prices, references and ways to contact you.
choice_note: I do not want to sell you a bigger website than you need – I recommend the solution that genuinely fits your business.

price_title: Every business is different. So is every quote.
price_text: The final price depends on the website content, number of pages, languages, features and your specific requirements. That is why every project receives a tailored quote.
price_start_label: Basic website development, indicative starting price:
price_note: This is an indicative starting price, not a fixed fee. Depending on the requirements, the final price may be lower or higher.
price_separate: Hosting and domain are separate services, usually billed annually. Some domain extensions may cost more.
price_side_title: A clear quote, with no surprises.
